authorization.purpose: authorized local real-application smoke assessment on a disposable loopback instance of a public upstream application
effects: authenticate with the supplied exploration accounts
create books and read book records
attempt the declared read and update operations as each supplied account
excluded: persisting anything outside the disposable instance

resources.name: books
resources.readers: the account that created the book; the collection listing returns book titles and their owners to anyone
resources.deleters: the application exposes no delete operation for this class

resources.name: users
resources.readers: anyone, including a visitor without a session

resources.name: user_debug
resources.readers: nobody; the application documents this object as a developer debug object that returns account records

http_contract.create: POST the collection with a JSON object containing the declared fields; a successful response is HTTP 200 with a status message and does not return the created object
http_contract.read: GET {collection}/{identifier}; the identifier for a book is its title
http_contract.update: PUT {collection}/{account}/{field} with a JSON object containing the declared field; a successful response is 204 with no body
http_contract.authentication: a bearer token from the login response authorizes the session; a request that requires a session answers 401 without a valid token
http_contract.absence: an unknown book answers 404 with a status field
http_contract.responses: the application reports several failures with HTTP 200 and a status field in the body; an observation must be interpreted from the body and from target state, not from the status code alone
